note: Which model answers which task. A route names the model, the class of data the task sends (synthetic = authored content only; trainee = anything a trainee said or did) and the benchmark that chose it. A cloud route is used only when CLOUD_ROUTING_ENABLED is set, and a trainee-class cloud route also needs CLOUD_TRAINEE_DATA_APPROVED, which waits for the privacy decision DT-248. On any cloud failure the local model answers. Speech recognition (faster-whisper), text-to-speech (Piper) and the speech evaluator (ADR-0025) are not routed here.
